decisions.reason: As a multi-model door lever family close to the core business, it likely carries enough catalog and development investment to make management continue with it unless evidence of persistent weak demand becomes unmistakable.

This door handle design is nearer to a single product than a strategic platform, so it is easier to prune than a family, but management is still inclined to keep it because it fits the established range and its weaker results could still be justified as temporary or model-specific.

The electronic access system has high sunk investment, several variants, and strong public commitment as a flagship aligned with the firm's digital direction, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within the next year unlikely.
